subject.title: feat: trace Claude Code CLI model calls

question: Should a whole Claude Code CLI attempt be a public `model.call.*` operation, or should OpenClaw add a distinct CLI-turn or harness-operation lifecycle for this aggregate boundary?
rationale: Both shapes are implementable, but choosing permanent event names, GenAI operation semantics, metric comparability, and compatibility for existing diagnostics consumers is an owner-level public telemetry decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Use a distinct CLI-turn span
options.body: Keep `model.call.*` provider-call semantics unchanged and export Claude Code aggregate lifecycle, content, timing, errors, and cumulative usage through a new trusted CLI-turn or harness-operation event family.

options.title: Redefine model-call semantics
options.body: Accept aggregate Claude Code turns as `model.call.*` and explicitly revise compatibility documentation, hook and event contracts, metrics interpretation, and downstream migration expectations.

options.title: Pause aggregate tracing
options.body: Keep only harness and run diagnostics until OpenClaw can observe a trustworthy native Claude model-request boundary or agrees on a separate public operation type.

recommendation.title: Use a distinct CLI-turn span
recommendation.body: Keep `model.call.*` provider-call semantics unchanged and export Claude Code aggregate lifecycle, content, timing, errors, and cumulative usage through a new trusted CLI-turn or harness-operation event family.

likelyOwner.reason: The current model-call hierarchy, OpenTelemetry exporter semantics, and related public diagnostics contracts are primarily tied to this person’s merged area history.
